scope: Exact correction of verified provider ownership and false cross-problem aliases; preserve all canonical identities and member state.
privacy: Only public problem metadata, exact links and input hashes retained. Raw HTML, scripts, account fields and session tokens are not included.
limitations: No proof that a historical member status can be moved or removed; no user-state migration is performed.
Original PDFs are hosted by Codeforces and linked by the corresponding Gym; printed original numbering is checked independently of dashboard ordering.
